name: locturne-web
description: locturne.com: waitlist landing page, privacy policy and terms (Cloudflare Pages + D1).

scripts.signups:count: wrangler d1 execute locturne-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups FROM signups"
scripts.signups:by-source: wrangler d1 execute locturne-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COALESCE(src, utm_campaign, ref, '(none)') AS source, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM signups GROUP BY source ORDER BY signups DESC"
scripts.signups:export: wrangler d1 execute locturne-waitlist --remote --json --command "SELECT email, src, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, ref, country, created_at FROM signups WHERE unsubscribed_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at"
